g.text: Friends play over UDP 7777 / 8888. Admins use
SSM Session Manager, so no inbound SSH.
pre-commit passes, GitHub Actions bakes the AMI
CloudWatch alarms publish to SNS, which emails
you and triggers Lambda to isolate the instance
and snapshot EBS. Auto Scaling relaunches in AZ
B; AWS Backup protects the data.
Wazuh on the home Kubernetes cluster polls
CloudWatch Logs with a read-only IAM role.

svg.text: RuneScape: Dragonwilds · private game server on AWS
Hardened image built by CI/CD, deployed with CloudFormation, monitored and self-healing
AMI = pre-built server image · OIDC = keyless CI login · SSM = admin access with no open SSH port · Falco = runtime threat detection
